name: Warslave
description:
About This Game

OLD SCHOOL SHOOTER, OPEN WORLD MINI-DOOM

Yeah, that's how we define Warslave. An old school linear shooter set in a beautifully handcrafted open world alien world. No skill trees, no perks, no roguelite elements; just pure action.

You are a convict who was sent to a hostile alien planet to serve your sentence. If you can survive till the end and reach the shuttle, you'll be free.

RUN!

This alien world has a dangerous feature. Randomly, it's sun is blocked and all creatures go crazy. When this happens, all you can do is to run and survive as your weapons don't work until you see the sun again. So run, dash, slide, double jump, you do whatever you have to do to survive the madness.

DEADLY ARSENAL

Fight your way through the exotic landscape with 8 weapons and 5 modifications for each where you can find in the world. Don't worry, you can collect plenty of ammunition from the aliens you're gonna kill. You'll only focus on becoming a terminator, a ravager in a hostile world.

DIFFERENT DIFFICULTIES

The standard mod is just for introduction. You die, you respawn from checkpoint and advance. The real deal starts in the others:

  • Ravager: Same game but with 4 respawn chances. And you have to find these "chances" across the world to claim them.

  • Heretic: Enemies have more accuracy and damage. You have 3 respawn chances.

  • Quaker: Enemies have maximum accuracy and damage. You have 1 respawn chance.

  • Fatality: Enemies have maximum accuracy and damage. Increased enemy numbers. Perma-death.

SERVE YOUR SENTENCE & BECOME FREE
short_desc: An old-school sci-fi shooter in an exotic alien world. Compact, open world mini-Doom.
